title: Commons CSV reports restartable UTF-8 byte positions
summary: The parent iterator wrapped a CharacterCodingException. The fix reported the second record at byte 8 with LF and byte 9 with CRLF. Reopening at byte 9 returned exactly the second record at local offset zero.

change.description: CSV-329 reports a coding failure during the parent-era lookahead. On the merge expect exactly `[a,b]` at 0 and `[c,d]` at 8.

notes: Each history starts in a fresh JVM on each measured deployment and uses the same compiled caller on both revisions.

The parent iterator wrapped a CharacterCodingException. The fix reported the second record at byte 8 with LF and byte 9 with CRLF. Reopening at byte 9 returned exactly the second record at local offset zero.
